digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center) test coverage and reconciliation
propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters were hardened at different times by different means, resulting in asymmetric test coverage: Cloud has byte-for-byte characterization pins and ADF depth tests, while DC has multi-page pagination proofs and rate-limiting matrices.

DC's shared field-mapping code is never exercised through WikiTextCodec, and DC's create-path field values and sanitizer boundaries are not pinned by value, leaving confidence in DC's defect-freedom dependent only on a live instance harness.
The ticket-type map is duplicated within adapters/ and lacks the single-source guard that status and priority maps already have, creating regression risk for both adapters.
Five enumerated contract tests are vacuous, asserting only shape and not the values their docstrings claim to pin, breaking the ability to detect mutations in the adapters' actual behavior.
Cloud's whole-project readers have never been tested past one page, while DC pagination is extensively tested, creating an untested operational edge on Cloud that mirrors known DC edge cases.
